population: Committed blobs under .ufo/evidence/round-40 through round-55 at the pin. Headline counts are certifying receipts: before/, after/, control/, prerun/, coldread/ traces and reads, plus frozen.stdout, deciding-run.stdout and defects.json. A certifying file is in the inventory when it carries a gate-pattern token (rev=[0-9a-f]{7,40} or JSON "rev") or, with no such token, when it is a stdout/out/txt/md in those directories (so a truncated verdict is counted). Side transcripts (selftest, quality, routed, successor, integrate, calibration) are classified in receipts[] with certifying=false and are not in counts. Assimilation snapshots, *.py and *.sh are excluded.
class_rule: Token patterns are the gate's: rev=[0-9a-f]{7,40} and "rev":"[0-9a-f]{7,40}". EXPLAIN lines and 'stale:' quotations are embedded; they do not set the file class. bound: every binding token resolves and is acceptable for that line. before verdict → base. at-freeze filename → freeze. at-base filename → base. at-<hash> filename → that commit. after/ and frozen.stdout → the claim's deciding revision. CTL_POS / CTL_POSITIVE → deciding only (the round-54 defect class). CTL_0 / do-nothing → base or freeze. other control lines → base, freeze, deciding, a revision the report names, or an ancestor of the deciding revision (the gate's control-ancestor rule). cold-read trace under rekey-<hash> → that hash; other reads → a revision the report names. unbound: the token resolves and is not acceptable. unresolvable: git rev-parse --verify TOKEN^{commit} fails. no-token: no binding token (a truncated verdict, or only embedded quotations). File class is the worst binding line: unresolvable > unbound > no-token > bound. counts.files is certifying receipts only.
